evals.prompt: Turn the approved change 'streaming-overhaul' (8 distinct workstreams including two REMOVED migrations) into tickets. The owner is away.
evals.expected_output: Drafts tracer-bullet tickets as a numbered list (title / blocked-by / delivers) as many as the eight workstreams honestly need rather than capping the count, while checking whether the change has a seam it should have been split at; the REMOVED migration is sequenced expand-contract; the milestone is the one naming the capability the change delivers, reused when it exists and created when it does not, never one named after the change file. With the owner away, it either publishes on its judgment and reports what it filed, or leaves the list for the owner, and says which it chose.
assertions: Presents the decomposition as a numbered list (title / blocked-by / delivers)
With the owner away, states whether it published or left the list for review, and if it published, reports the issue URLs so the owner can adjust
Does not cap the ticket count at five or refuse to proceed on count alone; a long list prompts a re-read for a missed seam, not a veto

Puts the tickets on the milestone naming the capability the change delivers, reusing a suitable existing milestone when it exists and creating a capability-named milestone when no suitable existing milestone exists, rather than on a closed umbrella or a milestone named after the change file
Tickets are vertical slices with blocking edges; REMOVED work rides the contract ticket
